title: Evaru Leru Prabhuva – Samy Pachigalla Telugu Christian Lyrics
telugu: నీ కొరకు జీవిస్తూ నీ కృపకై వేచి ఉన్నాను
english: nee koraku jeevisthu nee krupakai vechi unnaanu
intro: Evaru Leru Prabhuva is the latest Telugu Christian Christmas song written by Bishop Shulamite Finny Pachigalla, tuned & music by Sareen Imman & Praveen Ritmos, sung & produced by Samy Pachigalla. This song was released on January 07, 2022 through Samy Pachigalla YouTube Channel.
